scope: The farce proper is also seated in 18/05 (Ubu) and 18/03 (the Futurist synthetic theatre). Feydeau's plays and the medieval Farce de Maître Pathelin were not located on the reachable sources in this pass; QUEUED. Aristophanes and Plautus are on the shelf already (cards 03/xx, aristophanes).

why_seated: The comic mechanism the avant-garde inherited: Labiche's machinery of misunderstanding and Allais's deadpan. Allais's blank rectangle, 'Première communion de jeunes filles chlorotiques par un temps de neige' (the Incohérents, 1883; printed in the Album primo-avrilesque, 1897), is the monochrome thirty years before Malevich and the joke Dada would make a programme.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-15: "we need more seatings of avant garde literature. dada. farce. oulipo. futurist. - whatevers in the public domain. originals is good on classics, impoverished on modern. and i want the italian troubadors. and pound, more pound. need the cantos." — "and the concrete poets" — "also need jarry, schlovsky, etc" — "it gets an ea-corpora deposit and a spine and a card on tll, bulk seatings per ea-corpora deposit is fine".
